nodes.summary: A sequence $(e_n)_{n \ge 0}$ in a real normed space $E$ is a Schauder basis when for every $x \in E$ there is exactly one sequence of real numbers $(a_n)_{n \ge 0}$ such that the partial sums $\sum_{i < N} a_i e_i$ converge to $x$ as $N \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Schauder basis

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space that has a Schauder basis. Then for every dense subset $H \subseteq E$ there is a Schauder basis $(e_n)_{n \ge 0}$ of $E$ with $e_n \in H$ for all $n$, and likewise for every dense linear subspace $S \subseteq E$ there is a Schauder basis $(e_n)_{n \ge 0}$ of $E$ with $e_n \in S$ for all $n$.
nodes.title: Krein's theorem on bases in dense sets
